# Vorkerland prewar tree: WRK preparation and the autonomous districts before
# the Unity Tower. The builder emits it as shared focus history; the WKR tree
# includes the WRK roots, so copy_completed_from = WRK keeps prewar completion.
# Tooling reads prewar, wkr, vad, tva and settlement as one civil_war_focus view.

# --- civil_war_focus ---
focus_tree = {
	id = ADISCORD_vorkerland_prewar_focus

	# Each phase has a separate coordinate band and one absolute anchor; other
	# focuses use a prerequisite as relative_position_id. Keep cells unique.
	# Clausewitz routes links through their vertical midpoint: even row gaps
	# need a clear horizontal corridor.
	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 100
			NOT = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_vorkerland_collapse_started }
			OR = {
				tag = WRK
				tag = EYR
				tag = EGC
				tag = RIV
				tag = YOR
			}
		}
	}
	default = no
	continuous_focus_position = { x = 100 y = 555555 }

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Prewar WRK: independent industrial, military and evacuation choices.
	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

	shared_focus = WRK_measure_confederation_fault_lines

	# The centre and autonomous administrations can ratify common emergency rules before the
	# collapse. The alternative preserves the same time window but spends it on
	# reserves and district authority. Course flags are written on selection so
	# the two countries can react to one another without a polling event.

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Prewar WRK: the hourglass of discord. The centre's last year moves the
	# balance between the centre and the districts and the three camps whose
	# packages reach WKR, VAD and TVA at the split. The tower branch weighs
	# Worker's fate when no evacuation project has decided it.
	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

	shared_focus = WRK_face_the_hourglass

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Autonomous districts prepare their administrations before the federal split.
	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

	shared_focus = VAD_review_district_obligations

	# Districts answer the centre's last year: loyalty pulls WRK's balance toward
	# the centre, a district emergency rule pulls it toward the districts.

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Retired wartime stubs. Their IDs remain inert and reserved; the compact
	# claimant routes no longer expose or depend on them.
	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

	shared_focus = ADISCORD_vorkerland_stabilize_claimant_regime

}
